title: Sheafifying a resolution section cocycle gives its derived-adjunction class
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism, $q\in\mathbf N$, $F$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $I$ any injective resolution of $F$, and $V\to S$ etale. Use the prescribed sectionwise homology and cocycle sheafification maps of [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data]. Set $A=f^{-1}\mathbf Z[V]$, $J=I[q]$, and let $a:F[0][q]\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ$ be the shifted augmentation. Let $e$ be the sections shift and homology evaluation isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-resolution-cocycle]. For every chain map $c:A[0]\to J$, the image of $e(\mathrm{chainEvaluation}(c))$ under normalizationResolutionClass at $V$ is $\mathrm{abelianHigherDirectImageClass}(Q(c)\gg a^{-1})$, the explicit derived-adjunction class of [def-weil-pbc-abelian-higher-image-class]. This is a statement about the section cocycle and its sheafified class; it contains no rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison.

proof.text: Form the ordinary termwise adjunct d of c. The proved private unit_single calculation in DerivedAdjunctionSingleZero identifies the derived-adjunction unit on a single object with the ordinary unit and right-derived single unit. Expand the latter, cancel its quotient/single identity comparison, and use naturality of rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit along c. The result is Q(d) followed by the right-derived unit on I[q].

lean.statement:
theorem resolutionCocycle_adjunction_class {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (q : ℕ) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (V : S.Etale)
    (c : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj (RawRestrictedComparison.freeSheaf S V)) ⟶
        (normalizationShiftedResolution F I q).obj) :
    (normalizationResolutionClass f q F I).app (op V)
      ((normalizationResolutionCocycleIso f q F I V).hom
        (RawRestrictedComparison.chainEvaluation f V _ c)) =
      abelianHigherDirectImageClass f q F V
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimage
          (X := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj (RawRestrictedComparison.freeSheaf S V)))
          (Y := DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj (normalizationShiftedResolution F I q))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map c) ≫
          (normalizationShiftedAugmentation F I q).inv)
